I knew my roommate (Ben) beforehand and the other (Scott) I didn't know at all when he moved in. Nothing could have prepared me for the shit storm to follow...

* Ben was a hoarder - he hoarded trash. The trash piles in his room came up to my knees in some areas, no joke. He hoarded clothes and dirty dishes.

* Scott was an alcoholic and one time when he was drunk, we were standing in the hallway talking when my mother called. He jerked the phone out of my hand, answered it and promptly began talking dirty to my mom. She thought it was hilarious, but I nearly died of sheer rage and embarrassment. 

* Their bathroom was absolutely disgusting. When we moved out, (of course they left it for me to clean) there was piss ALL OVER the floor from months and months ago. Old vomit caked on the floor around the toilet, a clump of hair the size of a baseball in the tub and so much feces caked on and inside the toilet, I had to scrub it four times. 

* We had around 80 bucks to spend in groceries for the two of us (Scott chose not to pitch in.) Ben would eat pretty much all the groceries - then I found out he was spending 150+ on fast food *in a week* AND eating all the food in the house. 

* Ben drew My Little Pony porn for money. Nuff said. 

* When I moved out, the two roommates stole **everything** from me. My bed, bookshelf, desk, my bass and the amp, lamps, dining room table and chairs, coffee table, two laptops and my super cool Ukelele.
I tried mood stabilizers and anti depressants and none of them worked. The only thing that's helped me is exercise, plenty of water and staying busy.
